The model's only question is the noul 'Is this refund request unambiguous and consistent with its stated reason?', which is a judgment of reason plausibility.

The gate uses one threshold ('is_obvious.noul >= T → auto-approve; below → human queue'), so there is a single approve-or-escalate cutoff with no defined middle band between two thresholds and no auto-deny band.
